## Hong Kong Baptist University

::: {.paper}
[Causal Inference: Capturing Cause-and-Effect Relationships with Data]{.title}
[Undergraduate · Fall 2023–2025]{.meta}

An applied introduction to modern causal inference, covering randomized
experiments, regression, difference-in-differences, instrumental variables,
and regression discontinuity designs, with hands-on data work.
